title: Point Blank - AkWa's Random Attachments
description: Point Blank addon that adds some random attachments for Vic's Point Blank and Point Blank:Jelly
body:
Pack works with both Vic's Point Blank and Point Blank: Jelly
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

VPB: [https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank](https://modrinth.com/mod/vics-point-blank)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
PBJ: [https://modrinth.com/mod/pb-jelly](https://modrinth.com/mod/pb-jelly)

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The pack currently includes: 7 sights and 2 foregrips:

- ELCAN Sight
- SUSAT Sight
- Mepro Sight
- Kobra Sight
- Kashtan Sight
- Krechet Sight
- OKP Sight
- Bipod Grip
- Angled Grip

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Instruction: All you need to do is install VPB or PBJ. Then, if you do not already have one, create a folder named “pointblank” inside your “.minecraft” directory, and place the addon archive there without extracting it.

Enjoy!
